dispute_ticket.description: I was at the entrance from 9.00am. No car came. At 9.08 the driver cancelled and charged me S$8.00 as a no-show. He was not there. Please refund me.

chat_logs.content: I'm at the main entrance, I don't see any car.
Outgoing call to driver, not answered (rang 30s).
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $8.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-8112 booked trip RYDE-PX-012 from Tiong Bahru Plaza to Raffles Place. Pickup 09:00.
Driver GPS sync error: no points received 08:53 to 09:08. Last point 08:52 about 1.4 km from the pickup pin.
Driver pressed I'm Here. Location verification unavailable (GPS signal lost).
Driver cancelled with reason rider_no_show. No rider_boarded event.
$8.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time to cancellation_time, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit is inclusive: a wait of exactly this many minutes already meets it.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: The no-show test counts from driver_arrival_time, and a wait of 8 minutes (09:00 to 09:08) would meet the inclusive threshold. But the 09:00 arrival is only a button press with no location check: the last GPS point (08:52) is 1.4 km from the pin and GPS is missing until 09:08, and no other record shows the car at the pickup. The rider says no car came. Whether the driver really arrived at 09:00 cannot be settled from the records, so a person must decide.
